name: 2C-T-19
summary: 2C-T-19, also known as 4-butylthio-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a possible psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and 2C families.

uses.text: In his book PiHKAL (Phenethylamines I Have Known and Loved), Alexander Shulgin describes synthesis of the final intermediate of 2C-T-19 but did not bioassay the compound.
